selection: eligible validation BCE; earliest epoch/config on exact tie, separately per variant/encoder/head/seed
normalization: both query and code: shared camel/snake splitting, lowercase, letter/digit tokens joined by spaces; no token filtering, no truncation
alignment_features: 16 matching features with length slots zero; cosine; 64 elementwise products scaled by8; 64 absolute differences
control: lexical variant only once without encoder; reproduce previous matching FP32 seed1729
exports: chosen FP32 plus derived INT8/PTQ; separately selected ternary STE; all variants and seeds reported
primary: normalized_alignment / FP32 encoder / FP32 head / seed1729; validation AUC>=0.60 and >=0.03 above matched BM25 to consider a separately frozen reserve1 evaluation
reserves: neither reserve1 nor reserve2 is scored in this training command
limitations: validation reused in previous development; unknown upstream pretraining overlap; no candidate retrieval or LLM savings claim
